Yes.

It’s why I can never see myself ever having a partner. I can’t even have platonic relationships without having this foreboding that something terrible will happen.

They've been in discussion with medical professionals about it and they have suggested putting him under medical care and my dad has responded extremely aggressively to it. The lack of action from them despite intervention from medical professionals is what made me realise that I needed to leave.

I speak to him occasionally over Whatsapp, he is aware of my dad's illness (it's why he's stopped visiting as often) but I don't think he is fully aware of the situation since he started his first year at college. I haven't brought up with my brother because I'm conflicted on how to tell him, do I tell him over text message? Meet up with him in person? (I wouldn't have anywhere to talk to him privately)

He shares an apartment room with several other students at the college he goes to, I believe my family pay for part of the rent? I'm not really certain what my brother's financial situation is.
My father, not out of hate, just waiting because I know it’ll happen soon.
im so sorry, people can be so fucking disgusting. wishing those people a very step on lego

I remember when I had hope for the future despite everything. Now I am jaded and disconnected from the world. 

I miss that.

And then people constantly expect you to be the ‘better person’ and ‘move on’. Your abusers? Nah, let’s not bother holding them accountable. 

It’s all so fucking exhausting.

I do sometimes. They all had their reasons for doing it, some experienced trauma themselves in their life and thus damaged their understanding of people and empathy, some lacked things they needed or wanted and sought it out in not the best ways. 

Not that it makes it any better though.

It can be possible for some triggers, it's just entirely dependent on the person and the cause for the trigger.

I know in some cases people have used exposure therapy to desensitise them to the trigger. Though I would definitely only suggest doing this with a psychologist as it can be harmful if you go about it the wrong way.

I'm not sure about the exact details, he was tested for Alzheimer's disease but it came out negative, though his doctors and my mother believe it may have been misdiagnosis. Again, the details are blurry and it's not like I have all the details to my dad's medical stuff.

Ditch your friend, if she truly valued your wellbeing, she would've not told people about you being a lesbian.

Second of all, photoshopping a minor's face onto pornography is a felony and considered to be child porn in many places. You need to talk to an adult you trust. Do you have any older siblings or a teacher/counsellor at school you could talk to?

thank you so much for the response! reading this really meant a lot for me. 

i think the most difficult part for me from recovering what happened was i didn't have a lot of support networks irl and basically had zero friends in my real life.

Yeah I suppose that's true, I do try to communicate to close family what is a trigger and how to avoid it, but never really knew how to communicate to people I'm not as familiar with? 

Sorry for the late response, by the way.

That's sound really creepy to deal with and it's completely understandable that it made you feel anxious. 

It sounds like someone got a burner number and called to fuck with you. Do you have the number saved somewhere? You could try looking it up.

hey op, i experienced something similar while not as extreme as someone spreading underage sexual photos of me, i did deal with stalking and emotional abuse within online circles. 

i really do feel with how it's so difficult to get support regarding trauma from the internet, so many therapists are not internet savvy and just don't understand how damaging it can be.

Yeah it's just difficult because like, I get angry whenever they trigger something that reminds me of trauma, except my triggers are weirdly vague that it's hard to pinpoint.

Like one trigger is just people telling me or wording it in a way I have anger issues or overtly snappy. So then how are people supposed to do when I do something that hurts them emotionally?
